comments.author: Nelllemus
comments.body: This game is slowly dying... Everyday there is a decreasing number of active players, new players (not new characters) are so scarce and rare, I haven't seen internet adds, banners or any kind of publicity of this game for months, the seas are desolated and cities are almost empy... Well, I don't see a good future for this game for the next two years. I hope OGP will not close it, I really enjoy this game.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Weapon slot items only appear and are usable in battle if they belong to one of the weapon categories (Sword, Throwing Knife, Club/Staff, Spear, Bow, Gun, and Crossbow and Revolver in the Age of Revolution era). Otherwise, even if equipped, they do not count as a true weapon and therefore will be replaced by the default knife. They can still lose durability if you fight with them equipped, so be careful of that. And some, as you've noticed, don't even have models in-game, like the Cross here. Pity.
